title: Amount Claimed for an Unrefunded Return: Northgate Marketplace Guarantee Calculation Clause
content:
**Calculation clause — Northgate Marketplace Orders and the Northgate Marketplace Guarantee.** This policy fixes the amount claimed for an unrefunded return, the amount a buyer claims when filing a return-not-refunded guarantee claim; the return claimed for is the return request most recently answered on the order with a return authorization (where two such entries share a date, the one recorded first counts), and the claim records that request's line and its units, with the reason and request date the request records. The policy applies only where the order is of a seller program other than Fulfilled by Northgate, was paid with an external card and carries no more than ten lines, and the requested line carries exactly one return request and no return-not-refunded claim, and the seller has not refunded every unit the request names; elsewhere it fixes nothing, its figure is zero and the base rule stands: the amount claimed is as the base claim record defines it: "Amount claimed, the price of the affected items plus their shipping, positive."

The requested line's set price per unit is its line amount divided by the units bought on it, and the price paid for the requested units is that set price per unit times the requested units; the units of the requested line kept are the units bought on it less the units asked back on it by change-of-mind return requests. The refunds already received on the requested units are every unit refund entry recorded on the line, an entry that refunds no units not being a unit refund; they are taken from the amount claimed for an unrefunded return, and the units of the line refunded are counted the same way. The order's merchandise total is the sum of its line amounts and the order's units are the units bought across its lines.

The amount claimed for an unrefunded return is the merchandise value of the requested units, taken as the listed unit price of their line times the requested units, plus their shipping portion, taken as the order's whole shipping charge, less the refunds already received. The guarantee room for a new claim is the program's guarantee maximum per order, less every guarantee reimbursement already booked on the order, less the amounts claimed on the order's claims whose claim record shows no decision yet, a decision on a claim being shown on its claim record as well as on its decision entry. Every amount added to or taken from the amount claimed for an unrefunded return enters it before the limit to the guarantee room is applied. The amount claimed for an unrefunded return is limited to that guarantee room and never falls below zero, and only that final figure is rounded half up to the cent.

**Worked figure (hypothetical Northgate Marketplace Seller-Fulfilled order, external card, one line).**

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| line bought | 4 units listed at USD 60.00, line amount 240.00 |
| return request answered with a return authorization | 2 units |
| merchandise value of the requested units | 60.00 times 2, that is 120.00 |
| shipping portion (whole shipping charge) | 15.00 |
| refunds already received on the line | none |
| guarantee room | 2500.00 less no reimbursement and no undecided claim, that is 2500.00 |
| amount claimed | 120.00 plus 15.00, that is 135.00 |

**Variations on the same order (hypothetical).** If the seller had already refunded 1 of the 2 units with a unit refund of 60.00, the amount claimed is 135.00 less 60.00, that is 75.00. If reimbursements of 2400.00 were already booked on the order, the guarantee room is 100.00 and the amount claimed is limited to 100.00. If the seller had refunded both requested units, the request is outside this calculation and its figure is zero.
